name: Craftsman's Writ: Red Woolen Boots
summary: A transferable writ requests a pair of Red Woolen Boots and gives delivery and payment information. You need the writ to complete the exchange.

sections.title: The Written Request
sections.body: A faded note asks you to provide one pair of Red Woolen Boots. It includes where to deliver them and how payment is arranged. The writ can be transferred, but you need to possess it when you complete the exchange.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The writ requests one pair of Red Woolen Boots.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the boots?
faq.answer: The writ gives delivery information, and the marked location appears on your map.
The writ includes information about payment.
Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Do I need the writ to complete the exchange?
faq.answer: Yes. You must have the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.
